title: semantic-evidence-transaction.v1
description: Checksummed semantic evidence transaction. Embedded records become visible together or not at all. An incomplete final frame truncates on restart; checksum or reference failure rejects the transaction. Canonical schema owns fields; readers deploy first; unknown majors are inadmissible.

schema_version.description: Schema major version. Readers deploy before writers; unknown major versions are inadmissible.

transaction_id.description: Stable unique identifier for this transaction. Used for deduplication on retry.

ordered_record_ids.description: Ordered list of record identifiers embedded in this transaction. All become visible together or none do.

acceptance_fingerprint.description: Acceptance fingerprint of the delivery subject this transaction addresses.

checksum.description: Checksum over the transaction frame. Checksum failure on read rejects the transaction.
